_meta.notes: Comprehensive index of all thematic clusters (Level 4) and sub-clusters (Level 5) for the Federated States of Micronesia.

910.name: Early Settlement
910.description: Austronesian peoples settle the Caroline Islands chain.

sub_clusters.name: Austronesian Arrival
sub_clusters.description: Settlement of Yap, Chuuk, Pohnpei, Kosrae from Southeast Asia.

920.name: Nan Madol — Venice of the Pacific
920.description: Monumental basalt city built on artificial islets off Pohnpei; Saudeleur dynasty.

sub_clusters.name: Saudeleur Dynasty
sub_clusters.description: Megalithic basalt construction; 92 artificial islets; UNESCO World Heritage.

sub_clusters.name: Nan Madol Megalithic Architecture
sub_clusters.description: Columnar basalt walls up to 7.6m; log-cabin-style stacking; engineering mystery.

sub_clusters.name: Nahnmwarki System (Post-Saudeleur)
sub_clusters.description: Isokelekel overthrows Saudeleur; nahnmwarki paramount chiefs established.

920.name: Yapese Empire and Stone Money
920.description: Yap's sawei tribute system; rai stone money quarried from Palau.

sub_clusters.name: Rai Stone Money
sub_clusters.description: Massive limestone discs quarried from Palau; value based on history, not size.

sub_clusters.name: Sawei Tribute System
sub_clusters.description: Yapese receive tribute from outer islands; inter-island political hierarchy.

930.name: European Contact
930.description: Portuguese, Spanish contacts; whaling; missionary era.

sub_clusters.name: Portuguese and Spanish Contact
sub_clusters.description: Diogo da Rocha contacts Yap 1526; Spanish claim over Carolines.

sub_clusters.name: Whalers and Missionaries
sub_clusters.description: American whalers; ABCFM on Kosrae and Pohnpei; cultural transformation.

940.name: Spanish, German, and Japanese Colonial Periods
940.description: Three colonial powers in succession; Japanese era most transformative.

sub_clusters.name: Spanish Colonial Period
sub_clusters.description: Formal Spanish claim; Capuchin missions; limited administration.

sub_clusters.name: German Colonial Period
sub_clusters.description: Germany buys Carolines from Spain; copra trade; scientific expeditions.

sub_clusters.name: Japanese Mandate Period
sub_clusters.description: Nan'yō-chō; large Japanese settlement; Chuuk Lagoon naval base; sugar industry.

950.name: World War II in the Carolines
950.description: Operation Hailstone; Chuuk Lagoon devastation; bypassing strategy.

sub_clusters.name: Operation Hailstone — Chuuk Lagoon
sub_clusters.description: Massive US air attack sinks 60+ ships in Chuuk Lagoon; now premier dive site.

950.name: Trust Territory and Independence
950.description: US Trust Territory; four states formed; Compact of Free Association.

sub_clusters.name: TTPI Administration
sub_clusters.description: US strategic trust; education; health improvements; political development.

sub_clusters.name: FSM Independence (1986)
sub_clusters.description: Compact of Free Association; federation of Yap, Chuuk, Pohnpei, Kosrae.

960.name: Contemporary Federated States of Micronesia
960.description: Compact renewal; climate vulnerability; cultural preservation.

sub_clusters.name: Compact Renewal Negotiations
sub_clusters.description: Amended Compact 2003; trust fund; ongoing US relationship negotiations.

sub_clusters.name: Chuuk Lagoon Wreck Diving Heritage
sub_clusters.description: World-class WWII wreck diving; heritage preservation; tourism.

sub_clusters.name: Climate Vulnerability
sub_clusters.description: Low-lying atolls threatened; typhoon intensification; food security.
